decision.summary: Complete Evolution selector integration by exact requirement-tree identity and expose acceptance execution status without treating an observed proxy as official scoring authority.

changes: Added the frozen Evolution BookStack observed-proxy suite and bound it to the exact requirement-tree fingerprint.
Kept platform-provided ARCBENCH_TESTS_DIR and /workspace/tests ahead of bundled fallback.
Added source-kind-aware prompt labels and ARC_ACCEPTANCE_STATUS records for selection, execution, infrastructure failure, and unavailable acceptance.
Injected the Evolution interaction contract and fixed every direct codegen/repair prompt formatting call.
Fail closed on duplicate exact fingerprints and preserved the legacy unique-title compatibility path.
non_changes: No model, timeout, request-budget, or repair-round changes.
No platform upload and no platform Run creation.
No official public-test contents were edited.

py_compile.command: python -m py_compile main.py acceptance.py codegen.py guard.py llm_proxy.py requirement_order.py tests/test_main_helpers.py

handoff: This is a platform_unverified local artifact. Do not upload or create a Run without separate authorization. Any future platform evidence must bind this exact ZIP SHA to the task, submission/build identity, and official-versus-observed-proxy test source.
